class TestMapRatingToActions:
    """Tests for map_rating_to_actions pure function."""

    def test_helpful_returns_single_positive_agent_confidence(self, default_config):
        actions = map_rating_to_actions(FeedbackRating.helpful, config=default_config)
        assert len(actions) == 1, f"Expected 1 action for helpful, got {len(actions)}"
        assert actions[0].dimension == CalibrationDimension.agent_confidence

        assert actions[0].delta > 0, "helpful delta must be positive"
        assert len(actions[0].description) > 0, "Action description must be non-empty"

    def test_wrong_returns_single_negative_agent_confidence(self, default_config):
        actions = map_rating_to_actions(FeedbackRating.wrong, config=default_config)
        assert len(actions) == 1, f"Expected 1 action for wrong, got {len(actions)}"
        assert actions[0].dimension == CalibrationDimension.agent_confidence
        assert actions[0].delta == pytest.approx(-0.08), f"Expected -0.08, got {actions[0].delta}"
        assert actions[0].delta < 0, "wrong delta must be negative"

    def test_irrelevant_returns_single_negative_smaller_than_wrong(self, default_config):
        actions = map_rating_to_actions(FeedbackRating.irrelevant, config=default_config)
        assert len(actions) == 1, f"Expected 1 action for irrelevant, got {len(actions)}"
        assert actions[0].dimension == CalibrationDimension.agent_confidence
        assert actions[0].delta == pytest.approx(-0.03), f"Expected -0.03, got {actions[0].delta}"
        assert actions[0].delta < 0, "irrelevant delta must be negative"
        assert abs(actions[0].delta) < 0.08, "irrelevant magnitude must be smaller than wrong"

    def test_already_knew_returns_two_actions(self, default_config):
        actions = map_rating_to_actions(FeedbackRating.already_knew, config=default_config)
        assert len(actions) == 2, f"Expected 2 actions for already_knew, got {len(actions)}"
        dims = {a.dimension for a in actions}
        assert CalibrationDimension.agent_confidence in dims
        assert CalibrationDimension.surfacing_priority in dims
        conf = next(a for a in actions if a.dimension == CalibrationDimension.agent_confidence)
        surf = next(a for a in actions if a.dimension == CalibrationDimension.surfacing_priority)
        assert conf.delta > 0, "already_knew agent_confidence delta must be positive"
        assert surf.delta < 0, "already_knew surfacing_priority delta must be negative"

    def test_already_knew_correct_magnitudes(self, default_config):
        actions = map_rating_to_actions(FeedbackRating.already_knew, config=default_config)
        conf = next(a for a in actions if a.dimension == CalibrationDimension.agent_confidence)
        surf = next(a for a in actions if a.dimension == CalibrationDimension.surfacing_priority)
        assert conf.delta == pytest.approx(0.02), f"Expected +0.02, got {conf.delta}"
        assert surf.delta == pytest.approx(-0.04), f"Expected -0.04, got {surf.delta}"

    def test_custom_config_deltas_respected(self):
        custom = FeedbackCalibrationConfig(helpful_confidence_delta=0.15)
        actions = map_rating_to_actions(FeedbackRating.helpful, config=custom)
        assert actions[0].delta == pytest.approx(0.15), f"Expected custom delta 0.15, got {actions[0].delta}"

    def test_wrong_penalized_more_than_irrelevant(self, default_config):
        wrong_actions = map_rating_to_actions(FeedbackRating.wrong, config=default_config)
        irrel_actions = map_rating_to_actions(FeedbackRating.irrelevant, config=default_config)
        assert abs(wrong_actions[0].delta) > abs(irrel_actions[0].delta), (
            f"wrong magnitude {abs(wrong_actions[0].delta)} should exceed "
            f"irrelevant magnitude {abs(irrel_actions[0].delta)}"
        )

    def test_all_actions_have_descriptions(self, default_config):
        all_actions = []
        for rating in FeedbackRating:

        assert all(len(a.description) > 0 for a in all_actions), (
            "Every CalibrationAction must have a non-empty description"

    def test_all_deltas_in_range(self, default_config):

        for rating in FeedbackRating:

            total = len(result.enabled) + len(result.skipped)

            )
